hypothesis: The three continuation-v1 family winners contain an aligned common post-root policy improvement plus independent optimizer noise. An exact equal-weight parameter mean may preserve the common improvement while reducing seed-specific error.
claim_boundary: This is one post-hoc continuation-only candidate inspired by the completed continuation-v1 result. It is not a continuation-v1 rescue, a root checkpoint, or a general champion. No old continuation-v1 row is promotion evidence.

source.platform: Linux 6.18.35 x86_64, AMD EPYC 9V74, 9 visible CPUs

parent_result.interpretation: Only one of three independently trained family winners cleared both Screen-B lower bounds. continuation-v1 therefore remains failed and no family checkpoint is promoted.
parent_result.development_only_observation: All three family-winner point estimates were positive on the completed fresh component screen, and their anchor-relative parameter-delta cosine similarities were 0.704, 0.733, and 0.736. This observation motivates exactly one fixed soup and is not pooled with any new test.

root.role: Immutable root policy, value, belief, shortlist, and baseline continuation

construction.method: One equal-weight arithmetic mean of every loaded v6 Net float. Inputs are ordered by model FNV, full loaded bytes, then canonical path; shared bit patterns are copied exactly; other coordinates are summed sequentially in binary64, divided by 3, and cast once to binary32.
required_pre_efficacy_checks: all three source SHA-256 values and sizes match
root SHA-256 is unchanged before and after construction
constructor provenance names exactly three sources with equal weight
output is a finite current v6 checkpoint with no trailing bytes
exact three-copy wager symmetry holds in every wager-linked parameter family
the output SHA-256 and constructor stdout are bound in a committed execution addendum before fresh efficacy

forbidden_variants: any new candidate on a seed consumed by this plan

operational_self_control.required: Exactly zero margin, 0.5 score, zero SE, byte-equal reciprocal aggregate, complete footer, and zero caps or provenance errors. This is operational only.

aggregate_gate: complete footer, exact provenance, and zero caps or unfinished tails
fresh_continuation_screen.round_safety: For each round separately, score + 1.645*SE >= 0.5 and margin + 1.645*SE >= 0.
fresh_continuation_screen.stop_rule: If any validity, aggregate, or round-safety requirement fails, stop. Burn this seed and do not evaluate another soup or source checkpoint on it.

fresh_full_actor_safety_screen.dependency: Run only after the continuation screen passes and the authoritative role-coherent workflow completes validly. Mechanically bind the same authoritative rollout tail for candidate and baseline.
fresh_full_actor_safety_screen.inspection_rule: Complete both reciprocal orientations and validate raw files before inspecting efficacy.
gate: equal-weight reciprocal combined candidate match score >= 0.5
equal-weight reciprocal combined candidate point margin > 0
candidate score in each orientation >= 0.475 after inversion
zero caps, missing pairs, malformed rows, provenance drift, or operational errors
fresh_full_actor_safety_screen.stop_rule: If this screen fails, stop and burn both seeds. It is safety selection only and is never pooled with final data.

actor_family_dependency.invalid_role_result_rule: If the role test or reciprocal merge is invalid or incomplete, do not run either full-actor stage.
actor_family_dependency.world_800_exclusion: Both actors remain at 512 worlds. The conditional 800-world plan is separate and cannot be combined without a new fresh test.

final_promotion.status: Locked now; execute only after both screens pass and a separately committed addendum binds the soup hash and authoritative actor tail.
final_promotion.inspection_rule: Inspect no efficacy until all 50 immutable shards, sidecar hashes, completeness checks, and the reciprocal merge finish.
promotion_gate: combined candidate match score - 1.645 * orientation-stratified pair SE > 0.5
combined candidate point margin - 1.645 * orientation-stratified pair SE > 0
candidate match-score point estimate > 0.5 in each reciprocal orientation after inversion
zero caps, gaps, overlaps, incomplete shards, malformed rows, provenance mismatches, or operational errors
final_promotion.failed_panel_rule: A failed final panel burns both seeds and cannot select any alternate checkpoint, soup, weight, or actor setting. Only this final data may support promotion.

retain: source, plan, execution-addendum, constructor, root, input, soup, evaluator, and role-result hashes
exact constructor and evaluator commands plus complete stdout/stderr
compiler, flags, CPU, kernel, thread count, start/end UTC, wall and user time
all raw pair rows, complete footers, sidecar hashes, canonical merges, and validity reports
